name: dabingli
description: 大病历生成器 Android App：离线填写、病历生成与安全更新

scripts.dev:web: npm run build:domain && npm run dev -w apps/web
scripts.build:web: npm run build:domain && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test:web: npm run build:domain && npm run test -w packages/ai && npm run test -w apps/web
scripts.test:storage: npm run build:domain && npm run test -w packages/storage
scripts.coverage: node --experimental-test-coverage --test --test-coverage-include=src/core.js --test-coverage-include=src/generator.js --test-coverage-include=src/hints.js --test-coverage-include=src/depth.js tests/core.test.cjs tests/generator.test.cjs tests/generator.scoring.test.cjs tests/depth.test.cjs tests/review-regression.test.cjs tests/abnormal-pe.test.cjs
scripts.verify: node build.js && node tools/sweep-abnormal.js && node tools/case-table.js && node tools/verify-review-cases.js && node --test tests/*.test.cjs
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/typecheck-domain.cjs && npm run build:domain && tsc --noEmit -p packages/ai && tsc --noEmit -p packages/storage && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web
